$comment: Post-run leaderboard line (gap row-07), read by ios MorseKitCheck and android/desktop JUnit. Data, not code. Rule (the iOS summary card): accepted run -> headline 'Leaderboard: #<rank> · <metric rounded>' and detail '[New personal best · ]<correct>/<total> graded correct'; the server's verdict against the run -> 'Leaderboard: not ranked' + the reason; the device/network/name getting in the way -> 'Leaderboard: not posted' + the reason; in flight -> 'Leaderboard: posting…'. On Android the line is headline + newline + detail.

cases.name: server refused the run
cases.reason: speed too high for the audio
cases.headline: Leaderboard: not ranked
cases.detail: speed too high for the audio

cases.name: device or network in the way
cases.headline: Leaderboard: not posted
